title: Mobile QE- Appium
description:
**Job Description**
**What's this role about?**
The Mobile QE role focuses on validating mobile applications by designing and executing test cases, automating test scenarios, and ensuring high-quality releases using tools like Java, Appium, Selenium, and REST Assured.
  
  
**Here's How You'll Contribute**
**Key Responsibilitie**
**Core Capability**
Mobile (iOS/Android) Application Testing
  
  
**Technology Stack(Primary Skill)**
Mobile (iOS, Android) Testing, API Services, Appium, TestNG, Jira
  
  
**Secondary Skill Set**
Selenium, Android SDK & Xcode, Accessibility testing, Device cloud
  
  
**Job Description (Primary Responsibilities)**
Candidates will be responsible for design, implementation, and execution of functional & Non-functional tests to ensure the quality of all releases as well as maintain and execute automation test suites for mobile applications, particularly iOS and Android Native apps.
  
  
**About Us**

title: Engineer 4, Software Development & Engineering
description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.
  
  
**Job Summary**
This job involves designing and customizing new software applications to enhance functionality and user experience. It includes managing software updates and releases, and working with stakeholders to develop solutions that meet business needs. It mentors junior staff, manages technical documentation, and uses performance metrics to improve software reliability. Collaboration with Quality Assurance ensures compliance with technical specifications. The role also requires management of documentation, analysis of market trends, and participating/leading in collaborative development sessions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Job Description**

* Designing new software applications, analyzing system requirements and customizing applications to maximize functionality and user experience
* Assisting in the software update and release process, ensuring seamless roll-outs of new features
* Collaborating with stakeholders and cross-functional teams to identify requirements and integrate tailored software solutions
* Providing mentorship to junior engineers, nurturing a culture of technical excellence and collaborative knowledge sharing
* Managing the documentation process for all development activities, ensuring clear and accessible information for both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Tracking and evaluating software performance metrics, using data to inform decisions and enhance system reliability and user satisfaction
* Partnering with Quality Assurance to confirm that software complies with technical specifications, ensuring the delivery of reliable applications
* Leveraging market research and industry trends to drive project strategies and improve software products
* Participating in or leading peer programming sessions, design sprints, or prototyping sessions
* Consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
* Regular, consistent and punctual attendance. Must be able to work nights and weekends, variable schedule(s) as necessary.
* Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Employees at all levels are expected to:**

* Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.
* Own the customer experience think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services.
* Know your stuff be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.
* Win as a team make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.
* Be an active part of the Net Promoter System a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.
* Drive results and growth.
* Support a culture of inclusion in how you work and lead.
* Do what's right for each other, our customers, investors and our communities.

**Disclaimer:**
This information has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees in this role. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications.
  
  
Comcast is an equal opportunity workplace. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.
  
  
Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards that Comcast provides to compensate and recognize employees for their work. Most sales positions are eligible for a Commission under the terms of an applicable plan, while most non-sales positions are eligible for a Bonus. Additionally, Comcast provides best-in-class Benefits to eligible employees. We believe that benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most, and should help you care for those who matter most. That’s why we provide an array of options, expert guidance and always-on tools, that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality - to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. Please visit the compensation and benefits summary on our careers site for more details.
  
  
**Education**
Bachelor's Degree
  
  
While possessing the stated degree is preferred, Comcast also may consider applicants who hold some combination of coursework and experience, or who have extensive related professional experience.
  
  
**Relevant Work Experience**
7-10 Years

title: Principal Architect - ReactNative
description:
JD for SME - Reactnative Architecture
  
  
At Globant, we are working to make the world a better place, one step at a time. We enhance business development and enterprise solutions to prepare them for a digital future. With a diverse and talented team present in more than 36 countries, we are strategic partners to leading global companies in their business process transformation.
  
  
We seek an
**Expert-Level Python Open AI**
who shares our passion for innovation and change. This role is critical to helping our business partners evolve and adapt to consumers' personalized expectations in this new technological era.
  
  
Experience: 12 years- 18 Years
  
  
**Mandatory Skills:**
React Native architecture, JavaScript (ES6+) and Typescript
  
  
**Good to have experience :**
Presales,Proposales, RFP
  
  
We are seeking a highly experienced and passionate Subject Matter Expert (SME) in React Native to join our dynamic product development team.Ideally the candidate should be 10-15 years at least working with Mobile applications. Strong foundation in mobile development, architecture patterns and DevOps practices.
  
  
Responsibilities -
  
  

* Provide expert-level guidance on React Native architecture, best practices, and performance optimization.
* Design and implement scalable, maintainable, and robust mobile application architectures.
* Make critical technical decisions related to technology choices, frameworks, and libraries within the React Native ecosystem.
* A minimum of 6-7 years of React Native Experience.
* They should be experienced and well-rounded in terms of general solution design and application architecture frameworks and principles.
* They need experience with the concept of Super App/Host App - at least one of the team needs to lead this architecture design that has proven experience.
* Excellent communication and ensuring design patterns are well communicated across all teams.

In terms of 5 core technical skills:
  
  

* Strong Command of JavaScript (ES6+) and Typescript for scalable and maintainable code
* Deep understanding of React fundamentals (hooks, context API, Functional components)
* Mobile App Architecture and performance optimisation
* Understanding of lazy loading, memory management, reducing re-renders etc…
* React native bridges and their optimal development
* Experience integration 3rd party SDKs, APIs, and Libraries (Firebase etc..)
* Security & State Management
* Implementing Secure AuthN (OAuth, JWT etc..)
* Understanding of security, secure enclaves, local biometrics and the react native integrations for the same
* Encryption, cert pinning, obfuscation
* Managing complex app states using redux, recoil, mobx, and context API of similar technologies, efficiency is key.
* Understands and can manage pipeline/build, and app deployment considerations in a React Native world
* App signing, versioning,Automated testing (all disciplines within),Handling of App Store & Google Play Store, including OTA updates etc.

Bonus Points: Contributions to open-source React Native projects.
  
  
Good to Have :AI: Github co-pilot, Coda, Context Engineering, AI Native development
  
  
Create with us digital products that people love. We will bring businesses and consumers together through AI technology and creativity, driving digital transformation to impact the world positively.
  
  
*We may use AI and machine learning technologies in our recruitment process.*
Globant is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Globant is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.
  
  
Final compensation offered is based on multiple factors such as the specific role, hiring location, as well as individual skills, experience, and qualifications. In addition to competitive salaries, we offer a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about life at Globant here: Globant Experience Guide.
